capture_command: 把这个窗口有价值的内容录入信号塔
public_safe_summary: Bind verifiable runtime execution proof into the AI Film owner-domain directing path so ordinary directing actually traverses the canonical director system and a claimed full-system run can be mechanically verified without turning routine directing into durable planning backlog.
desired_effect: AI Film directing should actually execute the canonical director workflow and produce mechanism-backed evidence when full-system execution is claimed, while routine directing remains trace-only rather than becoming durable planning backlog by default.
problem_to_solve: Current AI Film canonical defines mandatory directing reads and route/gate behavior, and the shared Second Brain defines RuntimeInvocationReceipt, but the current AI Film owner canonical does not expose a mandatory runtime receipt proving that a directing invocation traversed the required system path.
success_condition: A normal AI Film directing invocation can be verified against exact canonical source/read/route/capability evidence; missing mechanism evidence yields UNVERIFIED; process compliance remains separate from output quality; and routine directing does not create a durable Signal merely because it ran.
risks: Self-declared execution could be mistaken for real system execution if actual read, route and capability evidence is not mechanically enforced.
assumptions: The current AI Film canonical repository remains the owner-domain authority for directing behavior.
unknowns: Whether any non-repository execution instrumentation already exists outside the current owner canonical is UNKNOWN.
dependencies: Any AI Film canonical write needed to close this gap requires a separately released owner-domain task and must not be granted by Signal admission.
